'''Bugs''' were any of a broad category of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] that were found on multiple [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

The [[Mountain Terrain Scout Transport]], a six-legged ground [[Walker/Legends|walker]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], became known informally as the "bug walker" for its insectoid appearance.<ref name="Carida: Heavy Duty">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030904carida|text=Carida: Heavy Duty|int=Carida: Heavy Duty}}</ref>
